description: Add only a short vertical dark steel musket barrel extending UPWARD from behind this north-facing human's right shoulder. It points toward the TOP edge, away from the viewer; never left or right. Body and hands hide the stock and grip. Only a narrow barrel and small brass sight are visible beyond the shoulder. Preserve every original body, head, arm, shorts and foot pixel. Same transparent canvas and pixel scale. No horizontal gun, second weapon or extra arm.
